# CookNextDoor

> CookNextDoor is a free hyperlocal platform connecting home cooks with hungry neighbours within 1 km in Singapore and Malaysia. Zero commission. No delivery. Direct payment.

## What is CookNextDoor?

CookNextDoor is NOT a food delivery app and NOT a restaurant marketplace.

It is a community platform where home cooks list extra food portions (typically 3–5 servings of a home-cooked meal) and nearby people self-collect directly from the cook's home. Payment is made directly — PayNow, PayLah!, or cash. CookNextDoor takes no commission and charges no fees.

## Key Features

- **Hyperlocal listings** — Food listed within 1 km radius of the buyer
- **Food Mood quiz** — AI-assisted mood-based meal matching (food-mood.html)
- **Cook profiles** — Public profiles showing cook bio, cuisine type, availability schedule, and active dish listings
- **Zero commission** — Cooks keep 100% of their earnings
- **Self-pickup only** — Buyers collect from the cook's location; no delivery
- **Direct payment** — PayNow, PayLah!, or cash between buyer and cook
- **Community trust** — Reviews, verified profiles, community guidelines

## Pages

- [Home](https://cooknextdoor.org/index.html): Discover home-cooked food nearby; browse active listings
- [Food Mood](https://cooknextdoor.org/food-mood.html): Quiz that matches meals to your current mood/craving
- [How it Works](https://cooknextdoor.org/meetup-guide.html): Step-by-step guide for buyers and cooks
- [News](https://cooknextdoor.org/news.html): Platform updates and community stories
- [About](https://cooknextdoor.org/about.html): Mission, team, and story behind CookNextDoor
- [Contact](https://cooknextdoor.org/contact.html): Get in touch with the team
- [Press](https://cooknextdoor.org/press.html): Media resources, brand assets, press releases
- [Sign In / Register](https://cooknextdoor.org/user-auth.html): Buyer authentication
- [Become a Cook](https://cooknextdoor.org/cook-register.html): Cook onboarding flow
- [List a Dish](https://cooknextdoor.org/cook-list-dish.html): Cooks list new food portions

## Who uses CookNextDoor?

1. **Home cooks** — casual or active cooks who have extra portions and want to earn from their cooking while reducing food waste
2. **Nearby consumers** — people looking for affordable, authentic home-cooked meals near them

## Mission

Reduce food waste, build neighbourhood communities, and help home cooks earn from their passion — one meal at a time.

## Business model

Completely free for cooks and buyers. No commission, no subscription, no delivery fee. Growth is driven by community trust.

## Location

Founded 2026 in Singapore. Operating in Singapore and Malaysia. Expanding to more Southeast Asian cities in 2025–2026.
